# mistertranslation.com — crawling is allowed everywhere.
# (This file changes nothing about what crawlers may read; with no robots.txt at
# all the default is already "crawl everything". It exists only to advertise the
# sitemaps below.)

User-agent: *
Allow: /

# The Bible project. The sitemap is regenerated by build.py on every build. The
# /v/ per-verse stubs are deliberately absent from it because they redirect and
# are canonicalised to their chapter, and a sitemap URL must match its page's own
# canonical. Do not "helpfully" add them. (No page on the site carries noindex
# since 2026-10-07.)
#
# No count is stated here on purpose: this file is NOT generated -- it is tracked
# and static -- so any figure written in it rots silently, and nothing reads these
# comments anyway (crawlers parse User-agent/Allow/Sitemap and ignore the rest).
# The live number is the build's own "verse cards: N published to S3" line.
Sitemap: https://mistertranslation.com/sitemap.xml

# /ask/ -- Dear Mr. Librarian (split out 2026-09-19, build_ask.py). Still served
# from this host, reachable via the Bible project's own nav.
Sitemap: https://mistertranslation.com/ask/sitemap.xml

# The five blogs moved to their own m8k.io subdomains on 2026-10-10; the old
# /finance/ /travel/ /health/ /notebook/ /west/ paths here 301 to them (Worker
# mt-redirects). Their sitemaps are listed at their NEW hosts -- a sitemap line
# may name another host (sitemaps.org cross-submission via robots.txt), and
# pointing at the old paths would hand crawlers a redirect instead of a sitemap.
# Each blog also lists its own sitemap in its own robots.txt.
Sitemap: https://ledger.m8k.io/sitemap.xml
Sitemap: https://notebook.m8k.io/sitemap.xml
Sitemap: https://regimen.m8k.io/sitemap.xml
Sitemap: https://abroad.m8k.io/sitemap.xml
Sitemap: https://west.m8k.io/sitemap.xml
